The rabbit is facing left, with its body curled slightly. Its fur is a mix of brown and grey agouti patterns. One foreleg is visible tucked under the chest, and one hind leg is partially visible extending to the right. The ears are upright but appear relatively short, typical of a juvenile or specific species variant. There are some dry grass stems on the surface.
